identity.title: Add Cross-Round Progress and Frontier State

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add explicit cross-round convergence state on top of normalized validation evidence. The system must distinguish FAIL->FAIL with measurable forward motion from true stagnation or regression. Introduce a conservative Progress/Frontier model that compares validation trajectories across rounds and records what changed, without deciding the next action yet.
human_pressure.goal: Make EverRun able to answer: are we closer to acceptance than the previous round, unchanged, regressed, or unable to tell?
non_goals: Do not add LLM policy or autonomous replanning in this pack.
Do not redefine test truth or acceptance criteria.
Do not require every validator to expose step-level detail; support partial evidence.
red_lines: Progress must be evidence-derived, not model opinion.
Unknown progress must remain UNKNOWN rather than being forced into progress/stuck.
A higher raw pass count must not hide a newly introduced regression in previously passing requirements.

machine_core.goal: Implement persistent per-round convergence state with progress classification and frontier representation, plus deterministic tests for progress, stuck, regression, and unknown cases.
acceptance: Persist round index and comparable validation snapshots across at least two rounds.
Classify cross-round state as PROGRESS, STUCK, REGRESSED, PASS, or UNKNOWN using deterministic evidence.
Represent frontier advancement when ordered/step-level evidence is available, while degrading gracefully to requirement/test-level progress when it is not.
Track resolved failures and newly introduced failures separately.
Tests cover FAIL-at-step-2 -> FAIL-at-step-4 as PROGRESS, identical failure as STUCK, loss of a previously passing invariant as REGRESSED, and insufficient evidence as UNKNOWN.
Expose the convergence snapshot in a form that a later controller can consume without reparsing logs.
invariants: Progress classification never changes the underlying validator verdict.
Previously passing critical invariants are tracked so regressions are observable.
The representation remains useful when only requirement-level outcomes are available.

must_check: FAIL->FAIL forward movement is distinguishable from repeated identical failure.
Regression is first-class and cannot be masked by aggregate progress.
UNKNOWN remains a valid conservative state.
reject_if: Progress depends on free-form LLM judgment.
The implementation requires all validators to emit identical detailed traces.
